description: Background plugin that shows a map-anchored card when a feature is clicked, for layers that opt in. No UI panel.

descriptionFull.title: Shows a popup card for a clicked feature on any layer whose config carries a `featurePopup` block. The card lists the layer's configured properties and can offer up to two actions, each emitting an event other plugins act on. Requires the deck.gl map engine; on Leaflet the plugin stays inactive, since MMGIS opens features there through its own click path. A vector tile layer whose features carry differing property sets may show 0 for a property a given feature lacks.

variables.featurePopup.title: (str) property holding the card's heading; falls back to the layer's useKeyAsName
variables.featurePopup.properties: (arr) property keys to list, in order; omit to list every property
variables.featurePopup.actions: (arr) up to two { label, event } pairs; a press emits plugin:feature-popup:<event> with { feature, layerId, latlng }

name: FeaturePopup
